entities.title: Stable event and occurrence identity
entities.definition: Persist and reconcile canonical event, occurrence, alias, lifecycle and public URL identity independently of mutable title, media and source copy.

confidence.basis: Release and linked-event contracts identify the requirement; full lifecycle registry remains incomplete.

unresolved_conflicts: Stable URL/lifecycle registry and full redirect/410/retention application remain release blockers.

entities.title: Locked route-to-archetype registry
entities.definition: Pin 100% of production route patterns and source pages to stable corrected archetype identities with exact source revision and fail-closed coverage.

confidence.basis: Corrected global archetype SoT reports 100% route and source-page mapping.

unresolved_conflicts: The corrected SoT is a Draft PR head and remains reconstructed/candidate rather than promoted UI authority.

entities.title: Stable semantic UI identity
entities.definition: Use archetype, semantic region, pattern, component contract, configured instance and ProductScreenState identities rather than CSS selectors, coordinates or visible text as cross-system keys.

confidence.basis: Corrected archetype contracts, component graph and action-map contract.

unresolved_conflicts: Many component dependencies remain unresolved candidates in the corrected graph; Product links therefore bind exact contexts without claiming promotion.

entities.title: Idempotent Search transport and bounded request path
entities.definition: Admit one physical Search request per platform cell, prevent duplicate transport, constrain payload and forbidden work, and preserve typed direct/relay failure evidence.

confidence.basis: Accepted Search production-health evidence.

unresolved_conflicts: Accepted health is deliberately minimal and does not authorize scheduled LLM or expanded release matrices.

entities.title: Authoritative action ledger and idempotent commands
entities.definition: Represent save, hide, restore, favorite, calendar and other strong actions as durable idempotent product commands and authoritative receipts rather than browser click claims.

confidence.basis: Analytics and personalization architecture define the invariant; capability coverage differs.

unresolved_conflicts: Not every intended action has a uniform authoritative store or trusted terminal callback.

entities.title: Optional identity and bounded session transport
entities.definition: Issue, verify and recover optional Yandex/email sessions and platform-bound test sessions without sending duplicate OTP, leaking credentials or gating the public static core.

confidence.basis: Search health broker and identity acceptance contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Search health sessions are accepted; cross-page identity UI and multi-account product state remain broader.

entities.title: Versioned semantic event and metric registry
entities.definition: Register stable event names, schemas, denominators, revisions, consent classes and metric formulas so telemetry remains traceable to product questions and authoritative facts.

confidence.basis: Accepted analytics contract; unified production ingest remains incomplete.

unresolved_conflicts: A unified production ingest, actor/session fact model and general daily aggregates are not yet complete.

entities.title: Immutable source/snapshot/build handoff
entities.definition: Bind exact repository SHA, checked SQLite snapshot, build/run IDs, manifest and artifact hashes before any static candidate publication.

confidence.basis: Production build and candidate evidence.

unresolved_conflicts: Current candidate may be blocked by independent browser/data gates; immutable handoff does not imply release readiness.

entities.title: Atomic complete-tree root promotion and rollback
entities.definition: Reconcile only an inactive complete root, switch traffic through controlled backend weights, verify stable smoke and retain the previous complete tree for rollback.

confidence.basis: Code and plan exist default-off; live infrastructure is absent.

unresolved_conflicts: Live root buckets, ALB, SWS, DNS apply and rollback drill remain NO-GO.

entities.title: Bounded outbox, retry and last-good preservation
entities.definition: Use idempotent durable queues, bounded retry, typed terminal state and compatible last-good projections so transient failure neither loses strong actions nor fabricates fresh output.

confidence.basis: Release, analytics, Search and incident contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Last-good is safe only when compatibility and upstream observation are proven; it cannot turn a stopped producer into PASS.

entities.title: Browser, device and native evidence capture
entities.definition: Bind acceptance evidence to exact release target, fixture, viewport, device, OS, browser, action and observed result, including real scroll and native handoffs where mocks are insufficient.

confidence.basis: Acceptance inventory and accepted Search platform health.

unresolved_conflicts: Native share/calendar/maps and full Safari/screen-reader matrices remain manual or incomplete outside bounded accepted flows.

entities.title: Explicit scoped Product Atlas MCP materialization
entities.definition: Later materialize reviewed Git SoT into a separate Product Atlas Penpot file through explicit Penpot MCP operations with exact file/page/revision checks, bounded mutation and read-back evidence.

confidence.basis: Current owner decision superseding plugin delivery.

unresolved_conflicts: Penpot is occupied by another design task and was intentionally not connected in this Git-only work.

entities.title: Purpose-specific consent, minimization and retention enforcement
entities.definition: Separate essential operations, product analytics, action-map diagnostics, personalization activation, research and communications; reject prohibited fields and expire weak diagnostics by policy.

confidence.basis: Analytics, personalization and action-map contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Unified production analytics ingestion and retention enforcement are not yet complete.

entities.title: Current event truth must remain coherent
entities.definition: No surface may present stale or conflicting event identity, occurrence, lifecycle, venue, admission or outbound destination as current truth.

confidence.basis: Critical-fact scenarios and production incidents.

unresolved_conflicts: A closed incident proves the guardrail was violated and repaired, not that the system is globally healthy.

entities.title: No false success
entities.definition: The interface and analytics must never claim a save, send, search, publication, registration or other outcome that lacks the capability-specific authoritative success condition.

confidence.basis: Product methodology, analytics and acceptance contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Some external actions can prove only navigation attempt and must remain labeled accordingly.

entities.title: Core public discovery must not require authorization
entities.definition: Home, public listings and event detail remain usable without Yandex/email identity; gated enhancements must fail without blanking the static core.

confidence.basis: Static-site and analytics contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Search remains intentionally gated; the guardrail applies to the base service, not every enhancement.

entities.title: Relevance must not collapse discovery diversity
entities.definition: Optimization for earlier event value must preserve controlled variety across categories, cities, organizers, event families and exploration slots.

confidence.basis: Analytics, personalization and acceptance contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Diversity targets and holdout evidence are not yet accepted as a production causal evaluation.

entities.title: Images must not distort or create unintended fields
entities.definition: Visual media scales proportionally; photographic media uses safe crop/fill, protected OCR/document content remains visible, and only the explicit multi-portrait gallery mode may show multiple vertical images without letterbox fields.

confidence.basis: Owner decision, media acceptance and corrected UI contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Not every consumer is migrated to one promoted media-frame contract.

entities.title: Static core remains usable when optional runtime fails
entities.definition: Search, personalization, analytics, identity, media or provider failure must not blank current public content, navigation, event detail or safe calendar access.

confidence.basis: Static architecture, degradation and release contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Public root release is not yet promoted, so complete production-root degradation evidence remains open.

entities.title: No cross-account or cross-context state leakage
entities.definition: Logout, account switching, anonymous-to-account merge and multiple tabs/devices must not expose another user's email, saved events, profile, tags or recommendations.

confidence.basis: Identity and privacy acceptance inventory.

unresolved_conflicts: Full cross-device and account-switch production evidence is incomplete.

entities.title: Purpose-specific privacy and consent
entities.definition: Optional analytics, diagnostics, personalization, research and communications use separate purposes, minimization, prohibited-field checks, retention and withdrawal behavior.

confidence.basis: Analytics, personalization and action-map contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Unified runtime ingest, deletion/export and retention evidence are not yet complete.

entities.title: Bounded LLM, network, database, storage and browser cost
entities.definition: No feature may create uncontrolled requests, raw telemetry firehose, unbounded storage, hidden LLM work or resource pressure that threatens product availability or free-tier budgets.

confidence.basis: Analytics, Search, release and action-map budgets.

unresolved_conflicts: A release-time full backup briefly reduced production disk free space to a critical margin.

entities.title: Accessible operation across input modes
entities.definition: Core controls, cards, navigation, dialogs and feedback remain understandable with keyboard, touch, pointer, screen reader, zoom/reflow, reduced motion and visible focus where applicable.

confidence.basis: Acceptance inventory and UI contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Screen-reader, high-contrast, Firefox/WebKit and native Safari coverage remains incomplete for several route families.

entities.title: Interaction and loading performance must not regress product value
entities.definition: Discovery, Search, diagnostics and visual changes must preserve accepted LCP/INP/CLS, avoid layout shift and never block navigation on optional telemetry.

confidence.basis: Analytics, action-map and acceptance performance contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Unified production Web Vitals and complete loading-state evidence are not yet available.

entities.title: Diagnostic action-map data cannot mutate personalization
entities.definition: Action-map exposure, local bins, retries, dead-area hypotheses, hover or absence of action never update the current profile or ranking; a new signal requires separate policy, benchmark and experiment.

confidence.basis: Canonical first-party action-map contract.

unresolved_conflicts: Active action-map capture is default-off and not required for public release.

entities.title: Git remains Product Atlas authority
entities.definition: Product definitions, statuses, evidence links, findings and decisions are reviewed in `events-bot-new`; Penpot is a projection and design-system stores foreign keys only.

confidence.basis: Product architecture and current owner instruction.

supersession_history.to: Git authority with explicit MCP projection

entities.title: No fabricated UI or Penpot bindings
entities.definition: A product-to-UI link must resolve to exact locked route/archetype/region/component/state identity; unknown Penpot file/page/shape IDs remain typed `binding_pending` and no UUID is invented.

confidence.basis: Current task boundary and corrected semantic SoT.

unresolved_conflicts: Actual Penpot bindings were intentionally not read because Penpot MCP is occupied by another task.

entities.title: Partner meaning remains unmodeled until researched
entities.definition: No venue, organization or commercial partner need, Job or outcome is inferred from existing pages, routes or operator requirements without dedicated research and owner decision.

confidence.basis: Explicit owner instruction.

unresolved_conflicts: Dedicated partner research has not been performed.
